title: Black Light Time-Aware Physical FTL Route Path Registry

designIntentSource.title: The different lightspeed methods
designIntentSource.scope: Family-specific gravity sensitivity, route miscalculation, predictive safety and realistic mathematical underlays require gravitational source positions to carry epoch and uncertainty rather than remain frozen forever at a catalog snapshot.

integrationPolicy.snapshotRule: The existing resolveFTLTimeAwareRoutePath runtime remains a bounded route-epoch snapshot: propagate every supplied authoritative gravitational source to one declared route epoch before physical route sampling.
integrationPolicy.familyEncounterAuthority: Family-dependent encounter timing is implemented by blacklight-exo-ftl-family-encounter-time-runtime.js and does not silently change the semantics of the snapshot resolver.
integrationPolicy.sourceRequirement: A source used for time-aware propagation requires position, velocity and source epoch. Missing velocity is unresolved motion, not zero motion.
integrationPolicy.covarianceRule: Propagated covariance and process-noise ancestry remain attached to the source-state packet. Missing covariance keeps the result PARTIAL rather than implying perfect certainty.
integrationPolicy.validityRule: OUTSIDE_MODEL_VALIDITY from source propagation blocks physical evaluation. It is not converted into a large finite route-severity score.
integrationPolicy.nextFidelity: Adaptive encounter-time path refinement and higher-fidelity N-body/post-Newtonian source dynamics remain future work; the family encounter-time layer now supplies distinct continuous, precommit and anchored-portal timing policies.

physicalMathematics.continuousEncounterTime: t(s)=t0+s*L/v_progress when the selected family/controller provides a defensible projected-progress representation
physicalMathematics.safeguard: Source-state propagation changes the gravitational source geometry supplied to ordinary gravity calculations; it does not establish any fictional FTL family as physically real.

CONTINUOUS_PROJECTED_PROGRESS.equation: t(s)=t0+s*L/v_progress only when v_progress is a defined route/control representation for that family
CONTINUOUS_PROJECTED_PROGRESS.warning: For true-FTL families, v_progress is not automatically a claim of local real-space superluminal hull motion.

PRECOMMIT_ENDPOINT.rule: Use explicit commitment and emergence epochs rather than fabricate intermediate ordinary-space encounter times or a local FTL speed.

ANCHORED_PORTAL.rule: Evaluate entry-mouth and exit-mouth environments at explicit anchor encounter epochs; do not imply ordinary-space traversal between mouths.

canonSafeguards: This registry does not establish that any FTL method is physically realizable.
Propagated source states are derived engineering estimates at a target epoch, not new historical canon.
Named race, vessel, manufacturer and installation sources outrank this generic integration layer within their documented scope.
A simulation-selected family does not establish that a named civilization uses that family.
Missing source velocity, covariance, epoch, acceleration or model-validity evidence may not be silently replaced by zero.
A route-epoch snapshot is not equivalent to a family-dependent encounter model; the distinction remains visible in API identity, provenance and documentation.
Fold, Q-Lattice and Phase Displacement may not be assigned a fabricated continuous superluminal progress velocity merely to simplify encounter-time mathematics.
Anchored wormhole/gate transit may not be represented as ordinary-space corridor traversal solely to reuse continuous route equations.
Ordinary gravity/curvature packets remain separate from operator-specific exotic boundary state.
